questions.question: Before coupling, how can you secure a second trailer?
questions.correctAnswerText: Set wheel chocks.
questions.explanation: Use wheel chocks to secure a second trailer while you are coupling it. This is especially important if you are unsure about the trailer's brakes.

questions.question: When parked on the side of the road, what should you do?

options.text: Use only the rear flashing lights.
Use one set of turn signals.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your four-way flashers.
questions.explanation: Turn on your four-way emergency flashers when you park on the side of the road. This is very important at night.

questions.question: Is rough acceleration a good practice?

options.text: No, it may damage the vehicle.
No, it may confuse other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, it may damage the vehicle.
questions.explanation: Speed up smoothly and gradually. Rough acceleration can harm your vehicle's engine and transmission.

questions.question: What happens when an engine is started?

options.text: Warning lights turn on, then turn off quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warning lights turn on, then turn off quickly.
questions.explanation: After starting your engine, warning lights and buzzers should go off after a few seconds. If they stay on, there may be a problem with your vehicle.

questions.question: What is the maximum air leakage rate for a triple combination vehicle in one minute?
questions.correctAnswerText: 6 psi
questions.explanation: A triple combination vehicle should not lose more than 6 psi of air in one minute during a leakage test.

questions.question: What should you know when driving a bobtail tractor?

options.text: Bobtails cannot drive as fast as tractors with trailers.
Bobtails take longer to stop than tractors with trailers.
Bobtails are illegal in most states.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bobtails take longer to stop than tractors with trailers.
questions.explanation: A bobtail is a tractor without a trailer attached. Bobtails need a longer distance to stop than tractors pulling loaded trailers.

questions.question: What is sleep debt?

options.text: Time needed to get ready to drive after waking up

questions.correctAnswerText: Not getting enough sleep
questions.explanation: Sleep debt builds up when you do not sleep enough. You can only pay back the debt by getting more sleep.

questions.question: What is reaction distance?

options.text: The distance you travel from seeing a hazard until you press the brake pedal
The distance traveled before you see a hazard
The distance traveled before you realize you must brake
The distance you travel from pressing the brake until you stop

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance you travel from seeing a hazard until you press the brake pedal
questions.explanation: Reaction distance is how far you travel between the moment you see a hazard and when you actually press the brake pedal.

questions.question: What equipment is required on truck tractors with air brakes made on or after March 1, 1997?
questions.correctAnswerText: Anti-Lock Braking Systems (ABS)
questions.explanation: All truck tractors with air brakes made on or after March 1, 1997 must have Anti-Lock Braking Systems (ABS).

questions.question: What is the best way to check your lights during a pre-trip inspection?

options.text: Park near a mirror to see the reflection
Turn on the lights, then get out and look at them
Check the instrument panel for warning lights
Drive in traffic and wait for other drivers to signal if lights are out

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on the lights, then get out and look at them
questions.explanation: During a pre-trip inspection, turn on your lights and then exit the vehicle to check them visually.

questions.question: When driving through fog, what should you do?
questions.correctAnswerText: Use low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in fog.

questions.question: What happens to shaded areas of the road?

options.text: Usually do not contain moisture, so they cannot freeze.
Will stay slick after ice on other parts of the road has melted.

questions.correctAnswerText: Will stay slick after ice on other parts of the road has melted.
questions.explanation: Shaded areas get less sunlight, so they stay cooler. They can remain icy and slippery after ice has melted on other parts of the road.

questions.question: If you see an aggressive driver crash ahead, what should you do?

options.text: Stop at a safe distance, wait for police, and tell them what you saw.
Block the driver in with your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop at a safe distance, wait for police, and tell them what you saw.
questions.explanation: Stop at a safe distance from the crash. Wait for police to arrive and tell them about the aggressive driving you saw.

questions.question: How does more alcohol in the body affect how it is removed?

options.text: The liver will digest it faster.
It will have less effect on the person.
It will take longer to remove from the body.

questions.correctAnswerText: It will take longer to remove from the body.
questions.explanation: The body removes alcohol at a fixed rate. More alcohol means it takes longer for the body to remove it.

questions.question: When driving down a steep hill, what should you do?

options.text: Shift to a lower gear, then use brakes to help control speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shift to a lower gear, then use brakes to help control speed.
questions.explanation: Shift to a lower gear before going down a hill. Use the engine's braking power as your main way to control speed. Use brakes for extra slowing if needed.

questions.question: What is true about convex mirrors?

options.text: They cannot be used on vehicles carrying hazardous materials.
They are illegal in most states.
They help drivers see a larger area.

questions.correctAnswerText: They help drivers see a larger area.
questions.explanation: Convex mirrors allow drivers to see a wider area than flat mirrors. Objects appear smaller and farther away than they really are.

questions.question: What is true about Anti-Lock Braking Systems (ABS)?

options.text: You can drive faster than normal.
You can follow other vehicles more closely than normal.
You can drive less carefully than normal.
It does not make your stopping distance shorter.

questions.correctAnswerText: It does not make your stopping distance shorter.
questions.explanation: ABS helps you keep control during hard braking, but it does not necessarily make your stopping distance shorter.

questions.question: What should a driver ensure about the truck?

options.text: The cargo is mostly in the front of the trailer.

questions.correctAnswerText: The truck is loaded correctly.
questions.explanation: Cargo must be loaded correctly for safe operation. Bad loading affects how the truck handles and can damage it. Loose cargo can also fall and cause injury or death.

questions.question: What might you be asked to do during a CDL vehicle inspection test?
questions.correctAnswerText: Check the engine oil level.
questions.explanation: The CDL vehicle inspection test includes checking the engine oil level as part of a full vehicle inspection.

questions.question: What should you do if you meet an aggressive driver?

options.text: Try to stay in their way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ignore hand gestures.
questions.explanation: Get out of the way if you can. Do not make eye contact, as this may provoke the driver. Ignore any hand gestures.
